However, the Year 1 amended spend for **Solicitation 01** and **Solicitation 02** can be calculated as follows:

### 1. Solicitation 01 (SOL-2026-CLOUD-01): 2,000 Hours of CLIN-0004-AB
* **Base Spend:** The original Year 1 total for 2,000 hours of CLIN-0004-AB (Cloud Security Architect Labor) was $420,000 at a base rate of $210.00/hr [04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf, p. 1].
* **Amended Spend:** Amendment 0001 increased the hourly rate to $245.00/hr and instituted a 5% volume discount when contracted hours exceed 1,500 hours in a contract year [06_Amendment_0001_Scope_Update.pdf, p. 1]. Both Amendment 0001 and Amendment 0002 confirm the Year 1 amended net total for 2,000 hours is **$465,500.00** ($2,000 \times \$245.00 \times (1 - 0.05)$) [06_Amendment_0001_Scope_Update.pdf, p. 1; 07_Amendment_0002_Vendor_QA.pdf, p. 1].

### 2. Solicitation 02 (SOL-2026-DATA-02): 6,000 TB of CLIN-1004 + 12 Months of CLIN-1002
* **CLIN-1004 (Active Lakehouse Storage - 6,000 TB):** The base annual total was $1,440,000 at a rate of $20.00/TB/mo [03_Pricing_and_Volume_Tiers.pdf, p. 1]. Addendum 0001 superseded CLIN-1004 to apply a 15% volume discount for storage exceeding 5,000 TB, reducing the effective rate to $17.00/TB/mo and bringing the amended annual total for 6,000 TB to **$1,224,000** [05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf, p. 1].

* **Solicitation 02 Subtotal:** $\$1,224,000 + \$576,000 =$ **$1,800,000** [03_Pricing_and_Volume_Tiers.pdf, p. 1; 05_Amendments_and_Addenda.pdf, p. 1].

### 3. Solicitation 03: 2,000 Hours of CLIN-2001 (Cloud Security Architect)
